        String word = "";
        int maxLength = 0;
        int count = 0;
        String input = scanner.next();
        int index = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {

                if (!word.isEmpty()) {
                    count++;
                }
                word = "";

                if (index == 1) {
                    if (!word.isEmpty()) {
                        count++;
                    }
                } else {
                    maxLength = Math.max(maxLength, word.length());
                }
                word = "";
            } else {
                word += character;
                if (i == length - 1) {
                    maxLength = Math.max(maxLength, word.length());
                }
            }
            index = (character == '(' || character == '_') ? 1 : 0;
        }
        System.out.println(maxLength + " " + count);
    }
}
